dispositions.sourceDisposition: Recognizes an externally supplied derivative measurement through profit or loss assertion under Section 11 of the February 2025 third edition (11.54). The Sec12 identifier is retained solely for compatibility; it does not select Section 12 fair-value guidance as the recognition/hedging authority. This source-reference correction does not implement a valuation or hedge-accounting algorithm.

Recognizes an externally supplied material-accounting-policy-information disclosure assertion under 8.5. Assess whether the information, considered with the other financial-statement information, could reasonably influence primary-user decisions. The older significant-policy label is not the third-edition criterion.

Recognizes an entity-supplemental capital-management information assertion. No standalone Section 8 mandate for generic capital objectives, policies and targets is identified in the supplied text; do not count this supplemental control as mandatory SME coverage without a verified specific basis. Additional material information may still be appropriate or required under other applicable disclosures.

Recognizes an externally supplied Pillar Two exception/disclosure assertion. Paragraph 29.3A requires neither recognition of related deferred-tax assets/liabilities nor the related information otherwise required by 29.39–29.40. In-scope entities disclose use of the exception under 29.42 and separately disclose related current-tax expense/income under 29.43. Paragraph 29.38 is not this exception authority; other income taxes remain separately assessed.

Recognizes an externally supplied joint-entity cost-model assertion, with cost-model eligibility/measurement separately evidenced. Operative 15.19(d) requires aggregate commitments relating to jointly controlled entities, including the entity share of jointly incurred commitments. Introductory amendment summaries do not erase that disclosure. Preserve and independently review the source-summary discrepancy.

Recognizes an externally supplied contract-price allocation assertion. Relative contract-start stand-alone selling-price allocation is governed by 23.42; 23.40 addresses an exemption. Alternative discount/variable allocation under 23.47–23.48 requires evidence that relative allocation does not represent expected entitlement and the alternative does. A legacy residual-approach state is not blanket authority for a full-IFRS residual SSP method; monetary allocation and exemption applicability require separate evidence.
